unit: fingerprint width / cardinality / key family / seed / query mixture

metrics.name: effective_fpr
metrics.tolerance: none; statistical uncertainty and nonnegative reference-repeat delta are required improvement margins, never relaxation
metrics.clears_when: On this workload, both point estimates and bounds are finite/defined and candidate.upper + calibrated_delta[workload][effective_fpr] < reference.lower; missing calibration is an author error; unresolved domain cannot pass

metrics.name: space_overhead_pct
metrics.tolerance: none; statistical uncertainty and nonnegative reference-repeat delta are required improvement margins, never relaxation
metrics.clears_when: On this workload, both point estimates and bounds are finite/defined and candidate.upper + calibrated_delta[workload][space_overhead_pct] < reference.lower; missing calibration is an author error; unresolved domain cannot pass

beats_reference: Every one of five metrics clears on every workload, including added shuffled25%-hit rows; all original and new correctness gates pass. No metric or workload may compensate for another.

statistical_contract.estimator: Worst per-construction empirical k/m across five repetitions; no pooling repeated queries
statistical_contract.interval: Bernoulli KL Chernoff inversion: m*D(k/m || p) <= log(2/alpha); alpha=(1e-6)/360 per construction; worst-value interval takes maxima of lower/upper bounds
statistical_contract.boundary: epsilon=0 or1: space point null, no pseudocount/floor, space predicate false; interval endpoint limits only; epsilon outside[0,1]/nonfinite is invalid
statistical_contract.calibration: judge/statistical_calibration.json must bind exact measurement sources and >=5 complete reference-only rounds; each nonnegative delta is max(point)-min(point); no successor solver results before freeze
statistical_contract.status: REFERENCE_CALIBRATED_EXACT_RUNTIME_PENDING; five retained rounds rederived under certified arithmetic; production runtime remains a separate gate
statistical_contract.arithmetic: Float root proposals are accepted only after directed Decimal interval certification of m*KL >= log(2/alpha); outward space transformation; unchanged point estimator and confidence level

score: Original descriptive mean of 100*R/(C+R) over resident/build/lookup, including every row. New accuracy/space predicates join strict conjunction independently; numeric score cannot imply PASS.
